# VP12 - Voltage converter

 · catalogue file [catalog/chips/VP12.json](https://github.com/RetroCoreLabs/RetroSchematic/blob/master/src/catalog/chips/VP12.json)

## Symbol

| As printed in ND-13.003.01, page 56 | Drawn in ND style | Drawn in modern style |
|---|---|---|
| ![VP12 as printed in the 1976 symbol manual](../../../catalog/symbols/nd1976/VP12.png) | ![VP12 drawn in nd style](../../../catalog/symbols/nd1976/shapes/block-VP12.png) | ![VP12 drawn in modern style](../../../catalog/symbols/modern/shapes/block-VP12.png) |

A rectangle for the whole function (or one section of it). Pin numbers are written on the lines where they meet the box; signal names are written beside them.

How to tell it on a drawing: Read the part type from the parts list and compare the pin numbers against this cut-out.

All symbols: [symbol catalogue](../../SYMBOL-CATALOG.md).
